correctness.rationale: For each generic direction sort the projected halfwidths xi>=eta>=zeta. Sweeping all twelve box edges gives positive-offset lengths (2zeta, 2(eta-zeta)+(xi-eta-zeta)_+, 2min(xi-eta,zeta), (eta+zeta-xi)_+) for 3,4,5,6 vertices, summing to xi+eta+zeta. Integrating with Haar dOmega dt (width-biased normals) gives p3=4T/s and p6=2Q/s, the remaining probabilities by the exact length identity. Spherical Stokes vector-area integrals give the stated arccos/arctan closed forms for T=E min(A,B,C) and Q=E(S-2max)_+. Coarea on a|U1|=b|U2| near c=0 gives Q/c^2->1/(2sqrt(a^2+b^2)) and hence the extinction constant 1/((a+b)sqrt(a^2+b^2)); the small simultaneous X,Y case contributes only O(c^3). Independently counted intersections of all 12 physical edges at 70,000 weighted normals for each of (1,1,1) and (.7,1.5,.3): max empirical discrepancy 0.0031. This is finite corroboration, not a substitute for the spherical/coarea proof.
